Relax, Restore, Repeat: Inside Our Garden Wellness Suite

Discover your new favorite retreat designed for calm, clarity, and coastal connection.

Minimalist Beach Stone Stack Tucked away behind a curtain of tropical greenery, the Coastal Garden Suite is a hidden gem built for travelers who need a little more than rest — they're looking for restoration. Whether you're in the middle of a personal reset, a wellness weekend, or simply craving quiet, this space is designed for mindful escape. Breathe Easier, Sleep Deeper The suite features hypoallergenic bedding, floor-to-ceiling windows, and an indoor-outdoor rain shower that lets in the sounds of the ocean. Guests also enjoy a private patio with a meditation corner — complete with a yoga mat, sound bowl, and ocean-scented candle. Wellness, Delivered to Your Door A highlight? Complimentary breakfast delivery each morning: think fresh-pressed juices, chia parfaits, and calming teas. You can also book add-ons like aromatherapy pillow sprays, salt foot soaks, or a guided breathing session. Sunrise Yoga & Spa Pairings Guests of the Garden Suite receive priority booking for our sunrise yoga on the sand and our herbal massage series. Looking for something unique? Ask about our wellness concierge who can build a custom relaxation itinerary just for you.

Mariven believes wellness should feel effortless — and this suite is proof. Sometimes, all you need is a soft robe, a quiet breeze, and space to breathe.
